# Cluster To Array preserves homogeneous I64 — alternate palette entry

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Homogeneous fields retain their exact integer carrier. An integer above 2^53 remains unchanged, and stable Cluster field order determines Array order.
